a: Clarify requirements, constraints, and scale before drawing boxes.
Estimate peak queries/sec from users × actions × seasonality.
Pick based on access patterns, consistency needs, and query shapes.
Add cache for hot reads; plan invalidation carefully.
Offload slow work to queues to keep APIs responsive.
Shard when a single primary cannot hold load; pick a good shard key.
Serve static assets from CDN close to users.
Protect public APIs with per-key and per-IP limits.
Plan logs, metrics, and traces from day one.
Document what happens when each dependency fails.
